Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
WotC has opened a chat room soley for discussion of tradeable
card games such as Magic, Vampire: The Eternal Struggle, Battletech,
and Netrunner. The chatroom will be open from 7/7/98 to7/13/98, after
which it will be closed again to allow the online staff to evaluate its
attendance and plan for more long-term goals involving this chat room.

This room, called "The Taproom," can be reached by going to the chat
login page:

http://tsronline.wizards.com:80/chat/world/html/login.html

Logging into the chatroom will place you in the "Lobby," a room for you
to take a breather and read up on the chat commands. Once you're
familiar with the chatroom, type /GO TAP and you'll enter The Taproom.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@wizards.com) VTES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
